title: Battle of Wakefield
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Wakefield", at revision 1370786203, opens: "The 'Battle' of Wakefield has traditionally been said to have taken place in Sandal Magna near Wakefield in northern England, on 30 December 1460. Recent research demonstrates that it was not a battle in the proper sense of a word, but a small-scale skirmish that resulted in the capture and subsequent deaths of Richard of York, 3rd Duke of York, his second son, Edmund, Earl of Rutland, and Richard Neville, 5th Earl of Salisbury." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q906912, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1460 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
